ValidationRule.description: Prevents users from creating Price Actions targeting an out-of-scope object.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: (ISPICKVAL(TargetObject__c, 'Product Option') && NOT(ISPICKVAL(Rule__r.TargetObject__c, 'Product Option') || ISPICKVAL(Rule__r.TargetObject__c, 'Configurator'))) || ((ISPICKVAL(TargetObject__c, 'Quote') || ISPICKVAL(TargetObject__c, 'Quote Line') || ISPICKVAL(TargetObject__c, 'Quote Line Pricing Guidance')) && NOT(ISPICKVAL(Rule__r.TargetObject__c, 'Quote Line') || ISPICKVAL(Rule__r.TargetObject__c, 'Calculator')))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Price Action Target Object does not match Evaluation Scope
